hints.ADMIN: I can look up the class hours of the teachers of a subject in a month.

ADMIN: How many class hours do the teachers have this month?

catalog.title: Labs
catalog.subtitle: Physics simulations, maths tools and language exercises to learn by trying.
catalog.none: Your institution has no labs switched on yet.
catalog.unavailable: This lab is not available in your institution.
catalog.fromClass: You opened the lab as it was in class. Change it as you like: your teacher does not see these changes.

categoryDescriptions.PHYSICS: Gravity, forces, speeds and trajectories, with numbers you can check.
categoryDescriptions.MATHS: Function graphs, a scientific calculator and formulas solved for any variable.
categoryDescriptions.LANGUAGE: Sentences to complete and definitions to find the word for.

descriptions.gravity: Drop an object on Earth, the Moon, Mars or Jupiter and compare how long it takes.
descriptions.forces: Release a block on a ramp with friction and see whether it slides down or stays put; push it and it can also go up.
descriptions.kinematics: Two movers on the same line: where each one is and when they meet.
descriptions.projectile: Launch an object at a speed and an angle: its path, its range and its highest point.
descriptions.function-grapher: Draw up to three functions of x and read their values anywhere.
descriptions.scientific-calculator: Trigonometry in degrees or radians, powers, roots, logarithms and factorials.
descriptions.equation-solver: Write a formula and solve it for any of its variables from the others.
descriptions.completions: Type the word missing from each sentence.
descriptions.definitions: Read the definition and type the word it defines.
